Commentary.Commentary: Right then, India have the bowling to defend this total but they cannot afford to take it lightly. A good start for Bangladesh will surely put them under pressure. Let's hope for a riveting chase. Do join us in a short while.

Jemimah Rodrigues is caught for a quick chat. Says that it's a decent score, not a winning one but they have a good bowling and fielding unit, so she's confident of defending the total. Wants her bowlers to bowl in the right areas and stick to the basics. On Shafali Verma's batting, Jemimah replies that she is a fearless character and something for all of them to learn. Quick wickets and dot balls, that's the recipe for success as far as Jemimah Rodrigues is concerned.

Bangladesh's bowling was below par at the start but they grew well as the game progressed. Skipper Salma Khatun was brilliant in her spell of 4 overs while Panna Ghosh, too, impressed by dismissing Shafali Verma and Harmanpreet Kaur. Their overall effort post the Powerplay has to be commended although they would have loved to keep India under 125 on this surface.

It all started with Salma Khatun's decision to invite India to bat first! Shafali Verma once again batted like a train on fire and provided a rollicking start. Jemimah Rodrigues also lent a useful hand but once both got dismissed, they struggled with the rotation of strike and also in finding the boundaries. Towards the end, Veda Krishnamurthy's little cameo helped them to get a score above 135.

Just 5 runs from the last over and that has stopped the Indian charge at the death! The Blue team had collected 23 from the two overs leading to the 20th but a brilliant final over by Jahanara Alam made sure that India didn't cross the psychological 150-run mark.
Full and just outside off, Krishnamurthy moves away to make room but she has to reach out for it. It takes the toe end of the bat and goes towards the off side for a single. INDIA END ON 142/6.
Fuller and around off, lofted over mid off for a run.

A dot now! Full ball around off, Pandey looks to reverse paddle but misses. They think of stealing a bye but Krishnamurthy sends Pandey back. Sultana, the keeper, hits the stumps at the striker's end but Pandey does well to make her ground.

Dropped! A simple chance but Panna spills it. Full and outside off, Pandey lofts it over cover-point. There is no timing on this one. It goes towards Ghosh at sweeper cover where she comes forward and gets to the ball but it does not stick in her palms. A couple taken.

NOT OUT! Impact is outside off, so Krishnamurthy can stay and smash a few more. A brilliant ball from Jahanara though. It is a superb yorker from her. Krishnamurthy tries to dig it out but she misses. She is struck on the pads. Alam appeals but not out says the umpire. This being the last over, Bangladesh go for the review. The replays roll in and show no involvement of bat first. Then the Ball Tracker comes and it shows that the impact is well outside off, so Krishnamurthy stays.
LBW appeal taken upstairs. Veda Krishnamurthy is the batter in question. The front foot is fine. There is no bat involved. Where's the impact? Outside off it is, so Krishnamurthy survives.
Swing and a miss! Length ball outside off, Krishnamurthy swings hard but misses.
Jahanara Alam was about to start her run-up but Veda Krishnamurthy moves away. Some problems due to the sightscreen.
Jahanara Alam to bowl the final over of the innings.
A dot to end the over! Full and around off, Pandey drives it straight to covers. 8 runs from the penultimate over.
Shortish and around middle, Krishnamurthy pulls it towards long on for a run.
Play and a miss! Tries to get cheeky but misses as Khatun bowls a quicker one just outside off, Krishnamurthy tries to guide it towards third man but misses.

FOUR! This time she cannot get away as she lands it full and just around off, Krishnamurthy is seeing the ball really well as she connects her sweep once again and sends the ball whistling away to the deep square leg fence.
WIDE! Another wide! Once again Khatun tries to stay away and bowls it well wide outside off, Krishnamurthy lets it be once again.
WIDE! Tries to keep away from the hitting zone of the batter and ends up spilling it wide outside off. Wide signaled.
Shortish and outside off, Pandey this time pushes it to deep point for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Pandey looks to force it towards the off side but misses.

FOUR! Another one! This is excellent batting from Krishnamurthy. She is providing the much-needed impetus to this Indian batting innings. Full and outside off, she firmly sweeps it to deep square and the ball races away to the fence. 15 from the over!
FOUR! Brilliantly timed! Full and just outside off, Krishnamurthy moves away to make room and then she chips it over extra cover to bag another boundary.
Flatter and around off, Pandey pushes it towards short third man and once again takes a quick run.

NOT OUT! Flatter and around off, Krishnamurthy taps it towards short third man and takes off for a quick run. There is a direct hit at the striker's end. The third umpire has been called in. The replays come and show that Pandey did well to drag her bat in time.
Another run out appeal referred upstairs.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary for India! Full and outside off, Krishnamurthy gets into position and sweeps it firmly to bag a boundary as the ball races away to the deep square leg fence.
Floated around off, Pandey chips it over mid off for a run.
Flighted fuller ball around off, Shikha drives it to long off for a run.
Shikha Pandey is the new batter in.

OUT! Deepti Sharma is run out! Complete hara-kiri! Full and flighted around off, Sharma sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and crosses for a run. Veda Krishnamurthy wants the second and straightaway rushes out for it. Sharma decides to respond but slips while turning. She then chooses to return while Veda keeps on running at the non-striker's end. The throw comes to the keeper who breaks the stumps immediately. Someone is definitely out but who is that someone is the question. The replays roll in and show that both batters are contesting for the same crease. It's touch and go, Deepti has the advantage of putting in the dive whereas Veda is the beneficiary of having a good head start. Whose bat is in first? Aahhhh...by a whisker, it's Veda who has won the race. Disappointed Deepti returns. India losing the plot.

Appeal for a run out! One of the batters is definitely out but who? Both are contesting to reach the same crease. Complete miscommunication. Deepti Sharma has lost the race to Veda Krishnamurthy and is gone.
Shortish and around off, blocked towards covers.

Another excellent effort from the fielder in the deep to keep it to a run. A shortish ball around off, Krishnamurthy pulls it towards deep square leg and thinks for a couple but the fielder in the deep does well to reach out and fire a throw at the keeper's end.
Veda Krishnamurthy is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Excellent running catch from Akter. Richa perishes in search of quick runs! Flighted fuller ball on middle, Ghosh slog sweeps it towards wide long on and tries to clear the ropes. But it is not timed too well. Akter from long on moves across to her right and holds on to a very good catch. Richa cannot believe it as she goes off.
Full and around off, Ghosh paddles it straight to short fine leg.
Salma Khatun is back on. 2-0-14-1 are her figures so far.
A single to end the over. Another short ball from Akter, Ghosh slaps it towards point where the fielder dives to make a partial stop. The batters cross over for a run.
A dot now as Ghosh fails to find the gap this time to this short ball outside off and ends up cutting it straight to point.
A couple now! Short and outside off, Ghosh slaps it through point and bags a couple of runs.
Appeal for an LBW from the bowler but nothing doing. A flighted ball around leg, Ghosh looks to paddle but misses to get hit on the pads. Pitching outside leg.
Full and outside off, swept to deep square leg for a run.
Short and around off, Deepti looks to pull but the ball stops on the surface. Deepti just about survives as she miscues it towards the bowler on the bounce.
Nahida Akter is back on. 2-0-15-0 are her figures so far.

FOUR! Another one, this is really poor from Khatun. Another half-tracker outside off, Ghosh pounces onto it once again as she slaps it through backward point for another boundary. 12 from the over, a good one for India.
FOUR! Poor ball and got the punishment it deserved. Short and wide outside off, Ghosh waits on the back foot and at the last moment slashes it through backward point for a boundary. 100 up for India.
Beaten! Another caught behind appeal but it is turned down once again. Shortish and around off, Ghosh looks to run it down to third man but misses. They appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Full and outside off, Deepti brings her sweep out and drags it to deep square leg for a run.
WIDE! Fuller and wide outside off, Deepti tries reaching out but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Short and outside off, Ghosh forces it to sweeper cover for a run.

Quick run! Loopy full ball on off, Deepti tucks it towards mid-wicket and completes a quick run as the fielder there tries to hit the stumps at the non-striker's end. She misses and replays show that it wouldn't have mattered.
Fahima Khatun is back on. 1-0-4-0 from her so far.
Full delivery on middle, Ghosh looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full delivery outside off, Ghosh slashes it over point for a couple.
Full delivery on off, Ghosh drives it to covers.
On a good length and outside off, Richa looks to chase this but misses it.
WIDE! Alam bowls it wide outside off, Ghosh leaves it alone.
Richa Ghosh is the next batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! She is short. Excellent work from Nahida and the keeper there. Low full toss outside off, Rodrigues drives it towards backward point and goes for the single. But seeing the diving stop at point Deepti stutters and sends her partner back. Rodrigues has to return from the middle of the crease as the throw comes at the keeper's end. She dives full length and tries to get in as Nigar collects the ball and takes the bails off. The decision is referred upstairs and the replays roll in to show that the dive has not saved Jemimah. This could be a big moment in the game.
Run out appeal is taken upstairs. That looks close.

Call is for two but they will settle for a run. Full ball on middle, Sharma whips it towards deep mid-wicket and calls for a couple straightaway. But the fielder in the deep charges ahead and gets to the ball quickly, so they settle for just a run.
Jahanara Alam is back on. 2-0-25-0 are her figures so far.
Full and outside off, Sharma once again powerfully sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE! Tries a similar ball again but it is way outside off, Sharma lets it go. Wided by the umpire.

Appeal for a caught behind but it is turned down! A flatter ball outside off, Deepti looks to force it towards the off side but she misses. The Bangladeshi players appeal but nothing from the umpire. The Ultra Edge rolls in and shows that there was no bat involved.
Swept well but only a run! Another full ball from Khatun, this one is on middle, Rodrigues sweeps it down to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Straight to cover! Very full ball outside off, Rodrigues drives it well but finds cover.
Full and on middle, Sharma this time flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Khatun starts with a flatter one outside off, Deepti looks to cut but misses.
Fahima Khatun into the attack now.

Quicker one on middle, Sharma turns it off his pads towards the vacant mid-wicket region and runs the first run hard. The bowler herself goes after it and stops the ball. Only a run results. Panna has bowled out, 4-0-25-2, outstanding work!
Up and over! A length delivery outside off, Jemimah chips it over covers and collects a single.
Nearly carries back to the bowler. Full and outside off, Rodrigues tries driving through covers but it takes the inner half and pops back towards the bowler. Not carrying to Ghosh.
Pitches it up and outside off, Jemimah plays a mistimed drive towards mid off.
Lands it on a good length and outside off, Deepti pushes it with an angled bat to point and steals a quick run. The fielder misses her shy at the bowler's end.
Steps down the track and flicks a full ball over mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, Rodrigues drives it uppishly past the bowler for an easy single.
Full and outside off, Deepti once again sweeps it behind square leg for a run.
Tossed up ball outside off, Sharma drives it towards covers.
Very full ball on middle, Rodrigues pushes it towards long on for an easy single.
Full and outside off, Deepti drags it via a sweep to deep mid-wicket for a run to get off the mark.
Floated on middle, Rodrigues strokes it to long on for a run.
Deepti Sharma is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The Indian skipper falls now. That was a poor ball to get out to. She should have left it alone but she goes after it. Had she left, it would've been wided. But Ghosh won't care. She gets her second wicket. Bowls it short and wide outside off, Kaur reaches out and tries to cut but it goes straight to Rumana Ahmed at point. 78/3 at the halfway mark!
Full and around off, Kaur finds the cover fielder.
Length ball on the pads, worked behind square leg for a run.

FOUR! Another misfield. Length ball around off, Rodrigues chips it towards wide long on. The fielder from  long on runs to her right and does well to get to the ball. It comes on her palm but it bursts through and falls on the fence.
Short and outside off, Rodrigues slaps it through point and bags a couple of runs.
Good length ball outside off, Rodrigues drives it towards mid off.
Knocks a full ball down towards long on and keeps strike with herself.
Misses out again! A low full toss around leg, Rodrigues sweeps but the backward square leg fielder dives to make a fine stop. Either side of that fielder and it would have been a boundary.
Loopy ball outside off, too full in length, Jemimah squeezes it out but finds point.
Lovely followthrough of the bat this time. A full ball on middle has been eased down the ground to long on for a run.
Floated full ball on middle, Kaur pushes it back to the bowler.
Extra flight on this one, it drifts in and lands full around off, Rodrigues drives it through mid off for a single.
Rumana Ahmed is into the attack.
Full and around off, Kaur drives it straight to the cover fielder. 7 from the over!
Short and outside off again, Kaur punches it straight to the point fielder.
Now an overthrow! Some sloppy work from Bangladesh at the moment. Fuller and around off, Kaur pushes it through covers for a run. The throw from the deep is not a good one and an extra run is taken.
Shortish and just around off, Rodrigues punches it through covers for a run.
Length ball outside off, Rodrigues looks to drive but misses.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! That is a poor stuff from Rumana at long on. Full ball around off, Rodrigues strokes it towards long on. Rumana there allows the ball to go through her legs and go to the fence. That will not please the bowler.
Slower through the air and around off and middle, Kaur keeps it out.
Excellent running between the wickets! Flatter delivery outside off, Rodrigues pushes it towards covers and takes a quick run.
Loopy ball on the pads, Rodrigues looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
Full and just outside off, this time Kaur drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
FOUR! Soft hands from the skipper! Shortish and outside off, Kaur waits for the ball and then simply dabs it past the short third man fielder. It races away to the fence in a jiffy.
Short delivery on middle, Rodrigues pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, Kaur thinks that it is outside the tramline and she lets it be, but it is well inside and is not wided. 54/2 at the end of the Powerplay for India.
Full and outside off, Rodrigues drives it well but the fielder at cover-point makes an excellent diving half-stop to her right. Certainly saved a boundary there. A run taken.
Just short of the mid-wicket fielder. Full and on middle, Rodrigues flicks it well and it goes uppishly towards mid-wicket but falls just short of the fielder inside the ring.
Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper, is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! One shot too many for Verma but this is how she bats. Fails to get the timing on this one and perishes. Full and just outside off again, Verma once again tries to launch it over long off. But she ends up miscuing it high in the air towards mid off. Shamima Sultana settles under the ball and tries to catch it over her head. It pops out of her hands but she keeps her eyes on the ball. Does well to lob the ball up again, then on the third attempt, she manages to gobble it. An excellent hand from the teenager comes to an end and she has provided a brisk start to India.
Short and outside off, Verma cuts it towards point.

SIX! 50 up for India in style. 4th maximum of the innings for Shafali. Just a check drive, more of a jab with plenty of bottom hand behind it and it sails over the ropes. Full and in the slot, Verma nonchalantly lofts it over long off for a biggie.
Panna Ghosh is on.
Low full toss outside off, Rodrigues eases it out to long off for a single.

SIX! Excellent use of the feet, this time from Rodrigues. She gets an applause from her partner at the other end. Floated ball just around off, Rodrigues skips down the track and launches it over mid off for a maximum. That was timed perfectly. She reminds everyone that even she is playing in the game.
Shortish and just outside off, Verma pulls it towards wide long on for a run. They wanted another run but the fielder in the deep was quick to the ball.
Full and outside off again, this time Rodrigues drives it to deep cover for an easy run.
Full and just outside off, this time Rodrigues finds cover.
Very full ball on middle from Nahida to start her spell. It is pushed to mid on.
Nahida Akter is into the attack.

A couple to end the over! Slightly short and around off, Verma looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge. The ball races towards third man. Short third man chases and slides to stop and give the ball back to the keeper. The batters scamper back for a couple. 5 from the over, another good one from the Bangladeshi skipper.
Full and outside off, Rodrigues sweeps it powerfully towards deep mid-wicket but only a run results as they have a protection in the deep.
Flatter and on middle, Verma flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.

Full and outside off, this time Rodrigues squeezes it through the gap between short third man and point. The short third man fielder dives but fails to stop. A single as the point fielder chases it and returns the ball.
Just short and outside off, Rodrigues cuts it towards point.
Loopy fuller ball outside off from Khatun, Rodrigues comes forward and keeps it out.
FOUR! Bang! 17 runs off the over and India are off to a flying start in spite of losing a wicket early. Right in the zone for Shafali. She attacks it well and thwacks it over the bowler's head.
Play and a miss! Another slower delivery by Alam. It's touch short and outside off, Shafali is early into the swing of her bat and misses.
Another aerial shot! These youngsters don't believe in playing along the ground. Another example is Prithvi Shaw. A length ball outside off, Shafali lifts it over mid off for two runs.
Third man comes in. Mid off drops back.

FOUR! Not from the middle of the bat but just enough to go over mid off. Slower one by the bowler, on the shorter side outside off, Verma throws her bat at it and it flies off the toe end. Evades the fielder at the edge of the circle and it's a boundary.
SIX! Shafali Verma is on the march at W.A.C.A.! A little bit of width outside off, Verma finds it in her zone and smashes it all the way over long off. This 16-year old is a special talent.
Alam goes very full and delivers it on middle, Rodrigues pushes it with gentle hands to mid on and scampers across to the other end.
On middle, Rodrigues flicks it towards long on to get off the mark.
Jemimah Rodrigues is the new batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! The Bangladeshi skipper strikes and the experiment of opening with Bhatia fails for India. Smart bowling from Khatun. She flights this wide outside off as she spots that Bhatia is skipping down the track. The ball turns away a hint to go past the defensive bat of Bhatia. Nigar Sultana, the keeper, collects the ball and quickly whips the bails off. No need to go to the third umpire as Bhatia is clearly out of the crease.
Short and outside off again, Verma pulls it to long on and changes her end.
Slower through the air on middle, Verma looks to flick but the ball takes the outer half and goes towards mid off.
SIX! Shafali Verma is on fire! Floated ball outside off, Verma gets in the position and whacks it over deep mid-wicket for another maximum.
Floated ball outside off, Bhatia looks to sweep but gets an under edge which goes past the keeper for a run.
Salma Khatun, the skipper, to bowl from the other end.
Length ball just outside off, Verma goes for the drive but ends up chopping it on the off side. 8 from the first over.

SIX! Just over deep cover! Poor ball from Alam though. Shortish and outside off, Verma reaches out and slams it over deep cover. The ball goes high in the air and the fielder in the deep for a moment thinks that she is in with a chance but the ball sails over her.
Missed opportunity! High full toss on middle, Verma does not hit it hard and pushes it towards mid on.
Crisp drive but only a run as there is a protection in the deep. Full and outside off from Alam, Bhatia drives it through covers and gets off the mark.
Shortish and around off, Bhatia taps it towards point and thinks for a run but they decide against it in the end as the fielder was quick to the ball.
WIDE! Bowls a length ball this time but it goes beyond the tramline on the off side. Bhatia goes chasing after it but misses. India are underway with an extra.

Jahanara Alam starts with a fuller ball just outside off, Bhatia leans into the shot and pushes it towards mid off. There is a mild appeal as the mid off fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end but Bhatia had her bat planted inside the crease.

All in readiness! The ladies concerned are out in the middle. Shafali Verma and Taniya Bhatia are the nominated openers for India. The effervescent Smriti Mandhana is going to be a big miss and we wish her a speedy recovery. Jahanara Alam to speed in first up with the new ball. Here we go...
Players from both the sides walk out to the middle for their respective national anthems before the action begins.

Pitch report - The square boundaries are quite short and hitting with the wind will be easy. The odd ball will grip and the seamers might get something out of it. Overall, it's a good cricketing surface.
Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Murshida Khatun, Shamima Sultana, Sanjida Islam, Nigar Sultana (WK), Fargana Hoque, Rumana Ahmed, Salma Khatun (C), Fahima Khatun, Jahanara Alam, Panna Ghosh, Nahida Akter.

India (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Richa Ghosh (In for Smriti Mandhana), Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Deepti Sharma, Veda Krishnamurthy, Shikha Pandey, Taniya Bhatia (WK), Arundhati Reddy, Poonam Yadav, Rajeshwari Gayakwad.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the Indian captain, says that, she wanted to bat anyway as she wants to put a big total on the board. Tells that the last game was a good start and it sets the tone for the tournament. Reveals that Mandhana is not playing as she has viral fever and Richa Ghosh replaces her.

Salma Khatun, the Bangladeshi captain, tells that the side is pretty confident after their warm-up games. On their recent win against India in the recently concluded tri-series, Khatun says that it was an excellent series for them. Tells that it is a big first game and they will try to do their best.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it falls in favour of Salma Khatun. She initially says that they will bat first but then changes her decision, so BANGLADESH WILL FIELD!

Time for the second match of the evening and it's involving two Asian teams - India and Bangladesh! The venue remains the same in Perth and we are expecting a great game. The Girls in Blue were magnificent as they thumped the defending champions in their tournament opener. Their confidence will be sky high at the moment and they will be eyeing a ruthless outing against their neighbours. For Bangladesh, they would like to start with a bang and upset India. Looking at their squad, bowling appears to be the stronger suit while the batting is thin on experience. Still, they have some quality players in Rumana Ahmed, Nahida Akhter, Ritu Moni, Ayesha Rahman and Fargana Haque and they would be hopeful of putting up a brilliant show. Stay tuned for more updates...
